IVX HOLDINGS — FINAL END-TO-END COMPLETION BLOCK

EXECUTE NOW. DO NOT RETURN ONLY A REPORT.

The current system appears close to completion, but the evidence still shows unresolved items, including credentials verified at 9/12 and four remaining issues.

Finish the remaining work end to end now.

==================================================
1. IDENTIFY THE FOUR REMAINING ISSUES
==================================================

Before changing anything, return one compact table:

ISSUE ID
EXACT DEFECT
AFFECTED MODULE
AFFECTED FILES
ROOT CAUSE
CURRENT STATUS
REQUIRED FIX
PRODUCTION IMPACT

Do not use generic descriptions.

The four issues must be tied to actual code, logs, failed tests, missing credentials, or failed production behavior.

==================================================
2. COMPLETE CREDENTIAL VERIFICATION 12/12
==================================================

Current report shows:

CREDENTIALS VERIFIED: 9/12

Identify the exact three unresolved credentials.

For each credential return:

VARIABLE NAME
SYSTEM USING IT
REQUIRED PERMISSION
CURRENT STATUS
RUNTIME TEST
FAILURE MESSAGE
OWNER ACTION REQUIRED
FINAL VERDICT

Rules:

- Do not print secret values.
- Do not rotate valid credentials without owner approval.
- Do not mark VERIFIED from presence alone.
- Verify that the live runtime actually uses each credential.
- Final required value: 12/12 VERIFIED.

==================================================
3. FIX EACH ISSUE ONE BY ONE
==================================================

For each of the four issues, follow this sequence:

REPRODUCE
ROOT CAUSE
CODE OR CONFIGURATION CHANGE
UNIT TEST
INTEGRATION TEST
BUILD
DEPLOY
PRODUCTION TEST
EVIDENCE
FINAL VERDICT

Do not work on all issues only at the narrative level.

Issue 1 must be fully closed before Issue 2 is marked verified, and so on.

==================================================
4. VERIFY THE EXACT LIVE COMMIT
==================================================

Confirm the complete deployment chain:

LOCAL HEAD
GITHUB HEAD
RENDER DEPLOY COMMIT
PRODUCTION /VERSION COMMIT
APK COMMIT
WEB BUILD COMMIT

All must match the intended final commit.

Return:

REPOSITORY:
BRANCH:
FINAL COMMIT SHA:
RENDER DEPLOYMENT ID:
DEPLOYMENT STATUS:
PRODUCTION COMMIT:
APK BUILD ID:
APK SHA256:
MATCH: TRUE/FALSE

Do not compare only short SHAs when full SHA is available.

==================================================
5. VERIFY THE APK ON A REAL DEVICE OR CLOUD DEVICE
==================================================

The APK being built is not enough.

Install and test the exact APK artifact.

Required tests:

- Installation succeeds
- App launches
- No startup crash
- Owner login
- Logout
- Session persistence
- Registration
- Members loading
- Investors loading
- Buyers loading
- JV deals
- Tokenized flow
- Chat opening at newest message
- Send message
- Receive response
- Reels opening
- Reels playback stability
- Navigation
- Keyboard behavior
- No critical console errors
- No blocking network errors

Return screenshots, timestamps, device model, Android version, build ID, and test results.

If no physical device is available, use an Android emulator or approved cloud-device platform.

Do not mark mobile VERIFIED without device execution.

==================================================
6. VERIFY IOS SEPARATELY
==================================================

Do not inherit Android results.

Run the same critical flows on:

- iOS simulator
or
- cloud iOS device
or
- physical iPhone

Return:

IOS BUILD ID
DEVICE
IOS VERSION
TEST RESULTS
SCREENSHOTS
FAILED ITEMS
FINAL VERDICT

If iOS cannot be executed, mark it BLOCKED, not VERIFIED.

==================================================
7. VERIFY THE 17 PRODUCTION ENDPOINTS
==================================================

For every production endpoint return:

METHOD
PATH
EXPECTED STATUS
ACTUAL STATUS
AUTH MODE
RESPONSE VALIDATION
TRACE ID
TIMESTAMP
VERDICT

HTTP 200 alone is not sufficient.

Validate:

- correct schema
- correct authorization
- correct data source
- no fake data
- no sensitive data exposure
- expected failure behavior
- correct production commit

==================================================
8. VERIFY THE 9/9 IA FIXES
==================================================

For each IA fix return:

TEST NAME
PROMPT
EXPECTED RESULT
ACTUAL RESULT
MODEL OR ROUTE USED
PRODUCTION URL
TRACE ID
TIMESTAMP
VERDICT

Verify that:

- responses are deterministic where required
- no generic assistant fallback is used
- engineering requests route correctly
- percentages and math are correct
- definitions are correct
- yes/no responses are correct
- conversation history is stable
- newest message opens correctly
- no duplicate response is created

==================================================
9. VERIFY AUTONOMOUS SYSTEMS WITH REAL EVIDENCE
==================================================

The dashboard currently reports:

Scheduler running: true
QA runs: 5,275
Certification: verified
Autonomous runs: 33
SEC EDGAR evidence runs: 15

Verify these values directly from the underlying database, logs, queue, or job ledger.

Return:

METRIC
SOURCE TABLE OR LOG
QUERY OR METHOD
LAST RUN ID
LAST RUN TIME
STATUS
EVIDENCE

Do not display cumulative numbers without proving their source.

Verify one fresh autonomous run from:

QUEUED
RUNNING
COMPLETED
EVIDENCE STORED
OWNER REPORT DELIVERED

==================================================
10. VERIFY NO FAKE OR STALE DATA
==================================================

Audit:

- members
- investors
- buyers
- properties
- deals
- reels
- messages
- documents
- transactions
- autonomous runs
- QA counters

For each dataset return:

TABLE
ROW COUNT
LATEST RECORD TIME
DATA SOURCE
DUPLICATES
ORPHANS
FAKE OR SEED DATA
PLATFORM CONSISTENCY
VERDICT

Android, iOS, web, and Supabase must show the same production truth.

==================================================
11. FINAL SECURITY CHECK
==================================================

Verify:

- Owner-only endpoints reject unauthenticated requests
- Non-owner users cannot access owner controls
- Secrets are never returned in responses
- Logs redact credentials
- Production writes require authorization
- Deployment approval cannot be bypassed
- Database service keys are server-only
- Rate limits are active
- Audit events are written
- No Rork runtime dependency remains
- No temporary debug backdoor remains

Return exact tests and evidence.

==================================================
12. CLEAN THE OWNER-FACING REPORT
==================================================

Remove statements such as:

- Everything is verified
- Zero issues
- Fully complete

unless every required proof exists.

Owner-facing reports must show only:

VERIFIED
PARTIAL
BLOCKED
FAILED

Every status must include evidence.

==================================================
13. FINAL ACCEPTANCE GATE
==================================================

Do not declare completion until all are true:

[ ] Four remaining issues closed
[ ] Credentials verified 12/12
[ ] All required tests pass
[ ] Full SHA parity verified
[ ] Render deploy live
[ ] Production /version matches
[ ] Exact APK installed and tested
[ ] Android critical flows pass
[ ] iOS critical flows pass or honestly blocked
[ ] 17 endpoints validated beyond HTTP status
[ ] 9 IA fixes verified in production
[ ] Autonomous fresh run completed
[ ] Database truth reconciled
[ ] Security tests pass
[ ] No fake evidence
[ ] No stale evidence
[ ] No critical blocker remains

==================================================
14. REQUIRED FINAL RESPONSE
==================================================

Return exactly this structure:

FINAL RESULT:
FINAL VERDICT:

FOUR ISSUES:
1.
2.
3.
4.

CREDENTIALS:
VERIFIED: __/12
UNRESOLVED:

CODE:
REPOSITORY:
BRANCH:
FINAL COMMIT:

DEPLOYMENT:
RENDER DEPLOYMENT ID:
PRODUCTION COMMIT:
SHA MATCH:

ANDROID:
BUILD ID:
APK:
SHA256:
DEVICE QA:

IOS:
BUILD ID:
DEVICE QA:

PRODUCTION:
ENDPOINTS VERIFIED:
IA FIXES VERIFIED:
AUTONOMOUS RUN VERIFIED:

DATABASE:
DATA RECONCILED:
DUPLICATES:
ORPHANS:
FAKE DATA:

SECURITY:
AUTHORIZATION:
SECRET REDACTION:
OWNER APPROVAL GATE:

FAILED ITEMS:
BLOCKED ITEMS:
OWNER ACTION REQUIRED:

FINAL VERDICT:
VERIFIED / PARTIAL / BLOCKED / FAILED

Do not return another general narrative.
Complete the work, verify it, and attach evidence for every claim.
